name: Bombirdier

abilities.name: Villainous Delivery
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Active {Darkness} Pokémon’s Retreat Cost is 1 less.

flavor:
Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle
up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys
dropping things that make loud noises.
